comparison.objective: Candidate screens ceramic media away from retained washers; pr-2031 aseptically spikes an IV bag and primes its drip chamber.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate tests bimanual screen grasping, controlled agitation, pass/retain selectivity, and loaded reseating; pr-2031 tests cap removal without sterile-interface contact, spike alignment/insertion, chamber orientation, and calibrated squeeze/release priming. Shared bimanual coordination and liquid-loss caution are generic.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires at least 98% recovery for completion, every washer retained, no spill or tunneling, both supports engaged, hands clear, and 3 s dwell; pr-2031 requires both caps removed, 23–25 mm spike seating, 15–27 mm fill height, no contamination or overfill, release, and 1 s rest. No material rubric detail is missing.
comparison.reason: Aseptic insertion and drip-chamber priming test sterile-interface handling and fluid metering, not selective rigid-body screening.
